headlines: SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 10 AM EST THIS MORNING

periods.name: This afternoon
periods.text: Northwest winds 15 to 20 knots becoming west. Rain. Waves 3 to 6 feet subsiding to 2 to 4 feet. Waves occasionally around 7 feet.

periods.name: Tonight
periods.text: West winds 15 to 20 knots. A chance of rain in the evening, then a slight chance of rain overnight. Waves 2 to 4 feet subsiding to 1 to 3 feet.

periods.name: Saturday

periods.name: Saturday night
periods.text: Southwest winds 15 to 20 knots diminishing to 5 to 15 knots. Partly cloudy in the evening, then becoming mostly cloudy. Waves 2 feet or less.

notes: See Lake Erie open lakes forecast for Sunday through Tuesday.
